newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 97/98 GDP growth forecast to be record low.
newsitem.headline: Japan 97/98 GDP growth forecast to be record low.

text.p: Japan will set a record low growth forecast for the gross domestic product for the fiscal year starting on April 1, Vice Economic Planning Agency Minister Shimpei Nukaya told a news conference on Wednesday.
The EPA has drafted forecasts for major economic indicators and reported the figures to Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on Wednesday morning.
The forecasts will be revealed later on Wednesday, Nukaya said.
"The prime minister approved the forecasts," he said.
Japanese newspapers reported on Wednesday that the official GDP growth forecast will be 1.9 percent in real terms, the lowest since the government starting forecasting growth in 1957/58.
"Our forecast figure will be a record low, but in terms of real economic growth, it is not the lowest," Nukaya said.
The EPA has come up with a more realistic forecast as the government plans to cut fiscal deficits as much as possible from the next fiscal year.
